items: **Universal Disability Enumeration:** Census 2027 will formally enumerate all **21 recognized categories of disabilities** specified under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act, 2016.

**Nodal Governance:** Implemented under the aegis of the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (MoS Ramdas Athawale) in coordination with the Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner of India (Ministry of Home Affairs).

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → Census 2027 covers all 21 disability categories recognized under the RPwD Act 2016 (expanded from 7 categories in 2011).
